_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email_display" TEXT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'es_CL', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mutation_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "protocol_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "request_hash" TEXT NULL, "dependency_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_attempted_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stream" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_change_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "stream"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("conflict_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_json" TEXT NULL, "remote_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" INTEGER NULL, "source_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "resolution_choice" TEXT NULL, "resolution_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("conflict_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "form_drafts" ("owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "draft_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parcels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "locality" TEXT NULL, "polygon_json" TEXT NULL, "area_square_meters" REAL NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sectors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parcel_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parcels (id), "number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (number > 0), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'crop', "polygon_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_square_meters" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (area_square_meters > 0), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("parcel_id", "number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "official_crops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "common_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "scientific_name" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_asset" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_crops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "description" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "crop_seasons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sectors (id), "agricultural_season_id" TEXT NULL, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_custom_crop" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom_crop" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agricultural_seasons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parcel_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parcels (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_migration_backfill" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_migration_backfill" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sector_irrigation_configs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sectors (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drip', "plant_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "emitter_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "emitters_per_plant_milli" INTEGER NULL, "flow_ml_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pressure_kpa" INTEGER NULL, "distribution_notes" TEXT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, "config_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parcel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sectors (id), "season_id" TEXT NULL, "crop_assignment_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_name" TEXT NULL, "details_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "details_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recorded', "supersedes_labor_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "soil_measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sectors (id), "moisture_percent" REAL NULL, "ph" REAL NULL, "temperature_celsius" REAL NULL, "conductivity" REAL NULL, "nitrogen" REAL NULL, "phosphorus" REAL NULL, "potassium" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "measured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "irrigation_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sectors (id), "labor_id" TEXT NULL, "irrigation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "soil_type_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "flow_liters_per_hour" REAL NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "estimated_liters" REAL NULL, "config_id" TEXT NULL, "config_version" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "applied_volume_ml" INTEGER NULL, "performed_details_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "irrigated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "crop_irrigation_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "soil_type_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "soil_multiplier_permille" INTEGER NOT NULL, "efficiency_permille" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minimum_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "maximum_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_reference" TEXT NOT NULL, "approved_at" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "irrigation_estimates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "irrigation_labor_id" TEXT NULL, "crop_assignment_id" TEXT NULL, "config_id" TEXT NULL, "config_version" INTEGER NULL, "algorithm_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "soil_type_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "inputs_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "estimated_liters_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recommended_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "warnings_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "explanation_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "calculated_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "production_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parcel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sectors (id), "labor_id" TEXT NULL, "season_id" TEXT NULL, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality_notes" TEXT NULL, "harvested_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("labor_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "captured_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("owner_id", "content_hash"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parcel_id" TEXT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_at" TEXT NULL, "android_notification_id" INTEGER NULL, "notification_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_error_code" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_installations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fcm_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'android', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "apiary_inspections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sector_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "beekeeper_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "hive_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "queen_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "brood_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "feeding_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "health_notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "pest_notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "super_installed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("super_installed" IN (0, 1)), "observations" TEXT NULL, "inspected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parcel_id" TEXT NULL, "locality" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weatherapi', "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NULL, "attribution" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent', "reply_to_client_message_id" TEXT NULL, "remote_response_id" TEXT NULL, "policy_version" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "export_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "manifest_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
